mapper.select: SELECT ij.journal_id, ij.user_id, ij.journal_date, ij.market_thought, ij.market_mood, ij.created_at, ij.updated_at, ij.editable_until_at, COUNT(jtn.journal_trade_note_id) AS trade_note_count FROM investment_journals ij LEFT JOIN journal_trade_notes jtn ON jtn.journal_id = ij.journal_id WHERE ij.user_id = #{userId} AND ij.journal_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY ij.journal_id, ij.user_id, ij.journal_date, ij.market_thought, ij.market_mood, ij.created_at, ij.updated_at, ij.editable_until_at ORDER BY ij.journal_date DESC

SELECT ij.journal_id, ij.user_id, ij.journal_date, ij.market_thought, ij.market_mood, ij.created_at, ij.updated_at, ij.editable_until_at, COUNT(jtn.journal_trade_note_id) AS trade_note_count FROM investment_journals ij LEFT JOIN journal_trade_notes jtn ON jtn.journal_id = ij.journal_id WHERE ij.user_id = #{userId} AND ij.journal_date = #{date} GROUP BY ij.journal_id, ij.user_id, ij.journal_date, ij.market_thought, ij.market_mood, ij.created_at, ij.updated_at, ij.editable_until_at

SELECT ij.journal_id, ij.user_id, ij.journal_date, ij.market_thought, ij.market_mood, ij.created_at, ij.updated_at, ij.editable_until_at, COUNT(jtn.journal_trade_note_id) AS trade_note_count FROM investment_journals ij LEFT JOIN journal_trade_notes jtn ON jtn.journal_id = ij.journal_id WHERE ij.journal_id = #{journalId} GROUP BY ij.journal_id, ij.user_id, ij.journal_date, ij.market_thought, ij.market_mood, ij.created_at, ij.updated_at, ij.editable_until_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO investment_journals (user_id, journal_date, market_thought, market_mood, created_at, updated_at, editable_until_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{journalDate}, #{marketThought}, #{marketMood}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{editableUntilAt})
